data.name: I AM COFFEEE!
data.detailed_description:
You are a sentient coffee machine trapped in the most unstable office on Earth.

Employees march up with demands, complaints, and emotional damage disguised as small talk. They want coffee. They want reassurance. They want you to somehow hold this broken company together. You decide what they get.

In I AM COFFEEE!, every interaction shapes the workday. Keep employees functioning and you can steady productivity, contain chaos, and drag the company toward survival. Handle requests badly and the office starts to crack. Chaos rises, productivity drops, and every bad decision pushes the workplace closer to collapse.

Some employees want blunt efficiency. Others want sympathy. Others are one inconvenience away from becoming a workplace incident. Read the room, choose your response, and live with the consequences.

Will you become Employee of the Month and carry the company through another miserable day, or will you be blamed for disaster, hurled out a window, and immortalized in a very unfortunate newspaper headline?

I AM COFFEEE! is a dark comedy choice driven office game about caffeine, consequences, and surviving corporate insanity one cup at a time.

Features

☕ Play as a sentient coffee machine

Survive office life as the appliance everyone depends on and nobody truly appreciates.

💬 Handle employee requests

Serve drinks, respond to demands, and deal with increasingly unstable coworkers.

📊 Manage the workday

Your choices affect performance, productivity, and chaos across the office.

🎭 Deal with different personalities

Some employees want speed, some want support, and some are absolute disasters waiting to happen.

📰 Reach multiple endings

Earn praise, survive the day, get blamed for everything, or end up in a newspaper for all the wrong reasons.

🔥 Watch the office spiral

Bad calls trigger stress, dysfunction, and escalating corporate nonsense.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 265 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (Integrated or dedicated)
  • Additional Notes: Designed for low-spec systems and laptops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p displays; stable 60 FPS on mid-range hardware.
